title: Marketplace Orders Refund Release Settings by Delivery Option
content:
The settings below decide, for each Marketplace Orders delivery option, when a return's item refund is released, the limits on a refund released at the first carrier scan, the refund deadline after the received-at-destination scan, the returnless price limit, where a gift order's refund goes, and whether the original shipping is refunded when an order comes back undeliverable for a bad address or a refusal.

| Delivery option | Refund trigger | First-scan maximum order total (USD) | First-scan minimum buyer account age (calendar days) | Refund deadline after received-at-destination scan (business days) | Returnless maximum unit price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | seller receipt | not applicable | not applicable | 2 | 10.00 |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | seller receipt | not applicable | not applicable | 2 | 10.00 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | carrier first scan | 500.00 | 90 | 2 | 15.00 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | carrier first scan | 500.00 | 90 | 2 | 15.00 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | carrier first scan | 500.00 | 90 | 2 | 15.00 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | seller receipt | not applicable | not applicable | 3 | not offered |

| Delivery option | Gift return refund destination | Original shipping refunded on a bad-address or refused undeliverable order |
|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | Northloop gift card balance | No |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | Northloop gift card balance | No |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | Northloop gift card balance | Yes |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | Northloop gift card balance | Yes |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | Northloop gift card balance | Yes |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | Northloop gift card balance | No |

## Notes

- The refund trigger is the earliest return milestone that releases the item refund: the carrier's first scan, or seller receipt.
- The first-scan limits have meaning only where the trigger is the carrier first scan. The account age is counted in calendar days from the date the buyer's Northloop profile was opened.
- "Not offered" in the returnless column means the item is always sent back on Large Item Freight Delivery.

### Hypothetical reading

A hypothetical Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day order totalling USD 500.00 is within the first-scan maximum; one totalling USD 500.01 is above it. A buyer profile opened 90 days before the scan date meets the 90-day age; one opened 89 days before does not. The figures are example inputs.
